layer.capability: Exact normalized eta derivatives of a^p through finite complete exponential Bell recurrence for rational h,j,sigma,Lambda inputs
layer.pinned_identity: a=exp(Lambda*realPhase)/C, a'=Lambda*realGradient*a, C independent of eta
layer.normalized_ratio_cancellation: The phase value and eta-independent C cancel from (a^p)^(m)/a^p; they remain in the unnormalized magnitude
layer.exact_input: Fraction Taylor derivatives of realGradient=-L*H/(H^2+sigma^2), with each coefficient multiplied by r!
layer.directed_decimal: Convert exact rational B_m outward with ROUND_FLOOR and ROUND_CEILING at the selected precision
layer.comparison: Before this change the legacy recurrence used binary64 gradient jets; current amplitude, wide-source, and formal-solver paths use the rational Bell provider, while the phase value remains numerical quadrature
layer.next_missing_reason: realPhase integrates the rational gradient across a possible narrow H-root region; fixed 4001-point trapezoids provide no error bound
layer.remaining_boundary: The Bell ratio is exact only for the rational input layer; phase, amplitude magnitude, schedule pressure, accumulated coefficient arithmetic, global norms, and paper-exact velocity remain outside this artifact.
